subject: Pilot DPA — limited-scope amendments and signature routing
messages:
From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@finops.io>

Cc: legal@finops.io
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood DPA for pilot — requested amendments

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the helpful demo last week — the product looks promising for our cost-forecasting pilot. Procurement/legal asked me to follow up on the DPA.

Two asks up front:
- Can you provide your standard Redwood DPA and indicate whether you accept a limited-scope amendment for a 6-month pilot (data residency + retention exceptions)?
- We have a few redlines reviewers will propose (SCCs + subprocessor notice timing). Would you accept a DocuSign route for quick execution if we sign an amendment?

For context: this is a pilot (up to 50k API tokens/month) and we need a focused DPA for EU data flows. Attaching our internal info-security checklist; legal will push redlines tomorrow.

Cheers,
Emma
Emma Jensen
Procurement Manager | FinOps, Inc.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood DPA for pilot — requested amendments

Laura / Marcus — forwarding FinOps request. They want a limited-scope amendment and rapid signature (DocuSign).

Quick notes:
- This is a pilot (50k tokens/mo) — low spend, but strategic reference if successful.
- They want SCCs (EU), short retention carveouts for logs during pilot, and 30-day subprocessor notice.
- Attachment: FinOps checklist (see Emma).

Laura: can Legal confirm whether we can accept a 30-day subprocessor notice and a one-off retention exception limited to the pilot? If so, recommend we produce an amendment (Redwood_DPA_Amendment_v1.docx) and route for e-sign.

Marcus: if Legal signs off, I’ll ask Emma whether they want the amendment attached to the order form or executed separately. I’d prefer separate DocuSign for speed.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood DPA for pilot — requested amendments

Soojin / Marcus —

We can accept a narrowly scoped amendment for a pilot with the following constraints:
- Retention exception: log retention extended to 90 days for troubleshooting during the pilot, documented in amendment, and automatically reverts after pilot term unless mutually extended.
- Subprocessor notice: we cannot commit to 30 days in all cases (some subprocessors require shorter notice). Offer a best-efforts 30-day notice with a clause allowing immediate notices where required by third-party change windows; commit to a 10-day minimum in practice.
- SCCs: we will include the standard EU SCCs and propose a short addendum that references our existing SCC implementation.

I attached a draft limited-scope amendment (Redwood_DPA_Amendment_v1.docx) with tracked clauses. Key callouts are in the draft: Section 2.3 (retention carveout), Section 4.1 (subprocessor notice).

Next steps:
1) I’ll upload a clean copy to DocuSign if they agree to the tracked changes.
2) Marcus — confirm commercial OK for pilot (discounting or credits) so we can commit to timing.

Laura Bennett
Corporate Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Amendment_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 45KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:09:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood DPA for pilot — requested amendments

Thanks Laura —

Commercial: we can offer a 3-month pilot credit up to $1,500 and waive the minimum committed capacity while they run the test. That should be sufficient to get quick signoff from FinOps.

Soojin: once Laura confirms language, I’ll drop the commercial terms into the order form and push for DocuSign. If they prefer signing the amendment separately, that’s fine.

I’ll also prep a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lists acceptance criteria for the pilot and the contact matrix (security + CSM).

- Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@finops.io>

Cc: legal@finops.io
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot DPA — limited-scope amendments and signature routing

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and Laura’s draft. Our counsel reviewed and attached a short PDF with two counterpoints: they want explicit language that the retention carveout applies only to logs generated by staff debugging requests, and they request a 30-day notice for subprocessor changes without carveouts.

We’re happy to proceed with DocuSign if Redwood will:
- Accept the limited log carveout language (we attached suggested text).
- Agree to a best-efforts 30-day notice with an escalation path if an immediate subprocessor change occurs.

Attached: FinOps_DPA_Redlines_20261117.pdf (application/pdf, 28KB)

Can we aim to have the amendment executed by end-of-week? Pilots ramp next Monday.

Emma
